summary: Iteration 15 — Web frontend regression for the Research Lab rename + Cockpit leaderboard re-org. All 6 requested scenarios PASS end-to-end against the shared backend (owner-authenticated). Sidebar nav tab renders as 'RESEARCH LAB' (data-testid=nav-tab-settings) with the FlaskConical icon. Clicking the tab shows the Research Lab page (research-lab-header) with title 'Research Lab' and subtitle 'STRATEGY VALIDATION · OPTIMIZATION SANDBOX · RISK & ENGINE CONFIGURATION'. Strategy Validation panel (strategy-validation-panel, y=272) renders FIRST — above the manual kill-switch section (settings-manual-kill, y=626) — followed by Risk Monitor & Manual Cycle → Graduation Scorecard → Performance Analytics → the existing Risk Thresholds / Adaptive Sizing / Exits / Vault / Friction / Operations / Breakout / Cooldowns / Housekeeping / API Keys panels (order preserved). Before owner login: readonly-banner shown, /api/lab/data/coverage returns 403 (owner-gated), 'No seeded history found' text renders and RUN VALIDATION button is disabled (correct read-only behavior). After owner login via OwnerAuthControl in header (owner@ananta.ai / preview password): readonly-banner disappears, asset-chip-* renders 10 chips (BTC, ETH, SOL, AVAX, XRP, PAXG, LINK, AAVE, ARB, RENDER), period-select shows options (3m default), run-validation-btn enabled. Clicking RUN VALIDATION opens validation-dialog with both track-current and track-fresh buttons; clicking track-fresh reveals param-select + values-input + folds-input (fresh-values-config); switching back to track-current + clicking submit-validation-btn triggers 'VALIDATION QUEUED' toast, runs-list populates immediately with a new backtest row (BACKTEST ETH/USD, SOL/USD — QUEUED) and a pre-existing WALK_FORWARD row (Hunter WFA — DONE) that already renders a download-pdf-* button. Cockpit tab (post-login): analytics-carousel (y=798) is preserved with the two existing slides (Counterfactual Engine pie + Confidence Distribution bar); new leaderboard-analytics section (y=1253) renders below with leaderboard-property-select dropdown. Cycling the dropdown through all 5 options (strategy, asset, exit, winloss, drawdown) updates leaderboard-pie + leaderboard-table live — verified strategy view shows UNKNOWN + HUNTER groups with net P&L ranked (t/win%/$ columns). todays-executions (recent trades) is now at the very bottom (y=1821), collapsed by default. Ordering assertion analytics-carousel.y < leaderboard.y < todays.y PASSES. Zero JS pageerrors. Console shows only the expected pre-login 403s from /api/lab/* endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx now hits 500+ lines (528). Consider extracting LeaderboardAnalytics, AnalyticsCarousel, Footer, ExecutiveHeader, WatchlistRibbon, ChartDrawer, OpenPositionsSnapshot into their own files under /components/cockpit/ — will help future testability + code review. Not a blocker; everything renders correctly today.

Settings.jsx is 940 lines. Given the page is now titled 'Research Lab' and mixes validation + risk config + housekeeping + API keys, splitting into ResearchLab/StrategyValidationSection.jsx (already extracted), ResearchLab/RiskThresholdsSection.jsx, ResearchLab/AdaptiveSizingSection.jsx, ResearchLab/ExitsSection.jsx, ResearchLab/HousekeepingSection.jsx would drop cognitive load significantly.

LeaderboardAnalytics.useMemo depends on `trades` from /api/trades (limit 100). If a user has >100 closed trades this breakdown will silently under-count. Consider paginating or bumping the limit specifically for the leaderboard slice.

Cockpit polls /api/trades every 15s via refreshAll. LeaderboardAnalytics recomputes pieData/leaders on every poll even if the trade list is unchanged — negligible today but worth memoizing on a stable hash of `trades` if the list grows.
leaderboard-property-select uses a plain <select> instead of the shadcn Select used elsewhere on the page — cosmetic inconsistency only.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner login MUST be performed via the header 'OWNER LOGIN' button (opens a modal with 2 inputs: type=email then type=password, submit button says 'SIGN IN' — no explicit data-testids on those fields at time of test). Consider adding data-testid='owner-login-email'/'owner-login-password'/'owner-login-submit' to OwnerAuthControl dialog to make future auth flows more deterministic. Without login, /api/lab/data/coverage returns 403 → asset-chips render 0 → run-validation-btn disabled — this is correct/intended behavior; do not flag it as a bug on an unauthenticated visitor. Stable Research Lab testIDs: research-lab-header, strategy-validation-panel, asset-chip-{BASE}, period-select, run-validation-btn, validation-dialog, track-current, track-fresh, fresh-values-config, param-select, values-input, folds-input, submit-validation-btn, runs-empty, runs-list, run-row-{first8}, run-status-{first8}, download-pdf-{first8}, run-summary-{first8}. Cockpit testIDs verified: cockpit-page, analytics-carousel, slide-counterfactual, slide-confidence, leaderboard-analytics, leaderboard-property-select, leaderboard-pie, leaderboard-table, leaderboard-row-{0..5}, todays-executions, today-trade-{id}, lifecycle-stepper. Track-B walk_forward can take 40-60s per the review request — 30 poll iterations of 2s each is a safe budget.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs.
